red ball held by child | lifted from the center of the bowl at 00:00-00:01 | vanishes/merges into the center red ball at 00:02 | duplicates upon lifting at 00:01 and disappears back into the bowl at 00:02

colored balls inside the bowl | 7 balls in bowl at 00:01 (2 red, 2 green, 3 yellow) | 6 visible balls of shifting colors at 00:09 (3 red, 2 green, 1 yellow) | remain stationary from 00:01 to 00:05, then spontaneously change colors and counts while being stirred between 00:06 and 00:09

findings.description: At 00:01, the child holds a red ball in both hands above the bowl while seven balls (two red, two green, three yellow) sit inside the bowl. When the child lowers his right hand at 00:02–00:03, the held red ball vanishes or merges into the center red ball, leaving the exact same seven balls (only two red) in the bowl at 00:04–00:05.

As the child stirs the balls, they spontaneously transform into different colors: between 00:07 and 00:08, a red ball in the upper-right of the bowl turns green; between 00:08 and 00:09, the yellow ball on the far right turns red, the red ball on the far left turns green, and the green ball at the front-left turns yellow.
